provenance.galleryTitle: Can two synth voices improve these recreations?
galleryIntro: Four external sounds: three rejected cases and one roughly similar cloth sound.
Compare the earlier option with a new single voice and a two-voice Mixr patch. All options are actual synth renders; no reference audio is used as a layer.
Choose the closest, then how close. This tests composition search, not a newly trained neural model.
provenance.scope: Four repeated external development sources, not held-out validation. No inverse retraining. Original Bfxr source controls may reflect old real-audio fitting. Footsteppr excluded from this bridge.
provenance.selectionPolicy: Alternating soft/preference ranks, unique PCM and maximum2 per synth. Test every pair and five balances; soft winner enters listening alongside soft-best single and exact prior candidate.

provenance.proposalPolicy: distinct mode primaries ranked by mode probability; fill with joint categorical beam; deduplicate canonical controls
